propositions: Unversioned public API removals without deprecation signals (major version bump, deprecation cycle, or CHANGELOG breaking-change entry) must be classified as unversioned_published_contract_break (SERIOUS 0.9 tier), while managed removals with any signal present remain unclassified.

Removed public symbols reachable via __all__, re-export, CLI command, or MCP tool must trigger a deterministic impact boost in the serious-maint lane when removal lacks version/deprecation signals, keyed on the export presence not on cited callers.
The frequency multiplier for churn-based findings must amplify only (never suppress) and never dampen SERIOUS-tier binaries, with churn=0 (new files) mapping to freq_mult=1.0 not 0.5.

The pass-2 verifier must add removed_public_symbol and version_signal_present boolean fields to CodeSeverityAttrs with deterministic FALSE defaults for abstention safety, feeding a derived boost that never lowers existing scores.
IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must bump from code-v4 to code-v5 to segment sidecars by impact-model semantics version, reflecting the changed behavior for removed-public-symbol findings.
